about.title: How to play
about.rules_1: Each game has eight panels and offers nine artists. Each artist is the right answer only once, so one of the nine names is a decoy.
about.rules_2: The panel opens on a detail, then widens. The top strip of the page, where the title and often the credits are, stays hidden until you answer.
about.points_2: Up to 100 bonus points if you answer while the bar is yellow, that is during the first 7.5 seconds.
about.points_3: On a keyboard, keys 1 to 9 pick an artist and Enter goes to the next panel.
about.modes_country: one mode per country as soon as nine of its artists have enough pages.
about.modes_kiosk: everything recently published in a country, wherever it comes from.
about.daily: the same panels for everyone, a single attempt, to share afterwards.
about.archives: the challenges of previous days, to replay as often as you like.
about.atelier: a few pages by each artist, to train your eye before playing.
about.source_text: First-page scans listed by {inducks}, the collaborative Disney comics database. Only stories credited to a single artist are kept. Images are displayed from Inducks and are not copied here.
about.credits_1: Part of this site's content comes from Inducks data, used under {licence}.
about.credits_2: The game builds on the idea of Duckguessr, created by the {dm} team.
about.credits_3: Disney characters and stories are © Disney. This site is a fan project, not affiliated with Disney.
